Big Pharma is the headline theme with a strong durability bar (0.84) and high crowding (z=1.46), while the rotation leader (Memory & Storage) is eligibility-gated out and unscorable for a clean view.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only trend-eligible theme with a high durability bar (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and a confirming val_state, suggesting the trend has stayed intact rather than breaking down. The absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg) is doing its job: the theme is eligible while many others are not. Crowding (z=1.46) is high, but per guardrails this is a sizing caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: High crowding (z=1.46) and full breadth suggest the trend is mature; large outperformance may already be priced, and a mean-reversion shakeout would hit a crowded theme hardest.

falsifier.text: PPH lags the S&P 500 by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care (Equal-Weight) is trend-eligible with a high durability bar (0.78) and strong breadth (0.917), riding the same defensive/healthcare leadership as Big Pharma but with less single-name concentration. The trend gate is supportive, and the theme is crowded but not a fade trigger.
theses.dissent: Equal-weight health care is highly correlated with Big Pharma; if Big Pharma rolls over, equal-weight health care likely follows, and the overcrowding (z=1.54) could amplify a drawdown.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 2% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is trend-eligible with a positive momentum score (0.655) and a moderate durability bar (0.48), but crucially it is one of the few non-crowded themes (crowding_z=0.31, crowded=false) in a largely crowded ranking. The absolute-trend gate is satisfied, and low crowding leaves room for continued trend participation without the reflexive blow-up risk seen in the crowded top themes.
theses.dissent: Energy breadth is 0.0, meaning the trend is not broad-based across the theme, and a lower durability bar (0.48) suggests the trend could fail more quickly than Big Pharma or defensives.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its own 20-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive trading days
